name: QM
invoke: run the role in whichever harness QM drives (Pi, OpenCode, Codex, Claude Code), or `mps agents show <role>` as the prompt
roles_note: QM has no per-role file format. Its deployment directory carries org tools (sandbox/tools/<id>/tool.json) and skills (sandbox/skills/<id>/SKILL.md), and the thing that actually reads a repository is the harness QM runs inside the sandbox.
notes: YC's multiplayer harness: Slack plus a web UI, one scoped workspace per person and per room, deployed into your own Fly or AWS account from a deployment directory validated by the `qm` CLI. It is harness-agnostic by design — Pi (default), OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code all drive the same core — so roles are installed for the inner harness, not for QM, and the routing block in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md is what carries them into a sandboxed session. Detection is by qm.config.jsonc, which lives in the deployment repository rather than in the project QM works on; a project vault will usually see the inner harness instead. If QM ever grows a repository-level agent format, this entry becomes a normal one — a JSON change, not a code change.
